name: VBOOT RO WP
description: VBOOT firmware images contain an FMAP WP_RO region that must not be writable after startup.
fwupd checks this region using MTD MEMISLOCKED when the firmware flash is exposed as NOR.
failure-impact: Without VBOOT RO WP, an attacker may be able to modify firmware code or data.

failure-results.not-locked: VBOOT RO WP is not enabled
failure-results.not-supported: VBOOT RO WP status could not be checked

resolution: Contact your OEM, who may be able to issue a firmware update.
